segments.name: Biopharmaceutical
segments.description: Discovers, develops and commercializes anti-inflammatory therapeutics targeting the complement system for patients with autoimmune and inflammatory diseases.
segments.evidence: We are a biopharmaceutical company pioneering anti-inflammatory therapeutics by targeting the complement system, an inherent part of the innate immune system.

revenueModel.text: The company earns minimal product revenue from sales of GOHIBIC (vilobelimab) to U.S. hospital end customers, and otherwise finances operations through securities offerings and grants.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenues reported are sales to end customers (hospitals).
